fusions.name: Seabed Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Packing Strokes
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drive Home
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Silt Pressure
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
